text: Past medical history: 10-year history of hypertension, currently managed with enalapril. History of smoking half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years. Social history: Smoker, half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Do you experience any wheezing or chest tightness during these episodes, and have you noticed any swelling in your face or lips since starting enalapril?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of enalapril use and smoking, I need to rule out medication-induced cough and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the chest X-ray is normal, I need to check your lung function to distinguish between asthma and COPD. REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry results confirm obstructive lung disease, and given your smoking history, this is consistent with COPD. However, since you are on enalapril, I must determine if the medication is contributing to your symptoms. Are you willing to stop taking enalapril for a few weeks to see if your cough improves?

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry confirms obstructive lung disease consistent with COPD, and while enalapril can cause cough, the normal X-ray and smoking history point more strongly to COPD. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
